upstream.compatibility_note: Published npm CLI 0.3.0 does not honor this source snapshot storage contract. The adapter verifies the audited source before spawning a query.

resolved_verification_failures: The first lifecycle fixtures exposed configuration placed in Node private storage. Configuration now lives at data_dir/obelisk.json, and the product CLI smoke confirms first configure/enable/status succeed.
Two concurrent rustc jobs were killed while building another dependency feature graph. Serial jobs=1 completed.
Shared-target worktree metadata was overwritten between invocations. The final build uses workspace-only codegen-units=17 and JSON-bound executable identities, preserving registry cache profiles.

The acceptance harness explicitly projects StoredSessionEvent fields instead of adding a production Serialize derive. External acceptance scenarios are standalone examples, preserving the source-policy prohibition on new ignored tests.

CI expect_used diagnostics also came from Tokio attribute macros implicitly expecting runtime creation to succeed. The lifecycle and external runner entrypoints now explicitly build a current-thread runtime with error propagation and block_on the unchanged async flows. All three were rebuilt and re-executed with new artifact identities.
interpretation: Mechanism assertions and the real external CLI path passed. One synthetic corpus with an unavailable model does not establish better recall, no negative research effect, or token savings. The real-model acceptance remains incomplete.
